title: Apple Explores Monetizing AI Through Subscriptions, Ties Cloud Intelligence Usage Quota to iCloud+
excerpt: Apple is testing daily usage limits for Apple Intelligence cloud AI features. According to the latest system betas, including iOS 27.3 Beta 2, and Apple’s updat
content_html:
Apple is testing daily usage limits for Apple Intelligence cloud AI features. According to the latest system betas, including iOS 27.3 Beta 2, and Apple’s updated support documentation, future server-side AI tasks that require high computing power will no longer be completely free and unlimited.

These limits mainly cover the new Siri AI, smart photo editing in Photos (Clean Up, Expand, and Spatial Reframe), Image Playground image generation, cloud-based large model calls in Shortcuts, and third-party apps that connect to Private Cloud Compute. Basic on-device commands, such as setting an alarm, are not affected. The quota is calculated independently for each device and resets every day at midnight local time.

For quota expansion, Apple plans to tie AI usage privileges to iCloud+ subscriptions. Subscribing to the 200GB plan ($2.99 per month) or higher can provide up to 2x to 20x quota expansion, with different storage tiers corresponding to different multipliers; the expanded quota can be shared within the same account and among Family Sharing members. The entry-level 50GB plan does not provide any quota bonus. Currently, Apple has not announced the specific number of daily calls.

This adjustment means Apple is exploring bringing cloud AI computing services into its subscription system, linking storage services with AI usage benefits to expand the monetization path for Apple Intelligence.
